title: 04 · File upload, neo-brutalist (Halftone Yard)
strengths: Details only a print shop would have: the job ticket bar ('JOB 4471 · 500 BUSINESS CARDS · 350 GSM UNCOATED · DUE THU 16:00'), '4-colour, 300 dpi', the error 'RGB at 150 dpi. Needs CMYK at 300 dpi.', registration marks and a colour control strip

The rows are a real table: name, size, a fixed-width bar and a status chip line up in every row; four states (passed, uploading 64%, queued, failed with 'Replace file') in context plus button, dropzone, progress and badge sheets
Palette discipline: newsprint, ink and the three process inks at full strength; the yellow button gets dark text by itself
slop_signals: Almost every word is caps at 800 or 900: 'SEND YOUR FILES', 'DROP PRINT FILES HERE', 'WE CHECK EVERY FILE BEFORE IT TOUCHES THE PRESS...', '1 OF 4 READY', 'SEND TO PRESS'; the voice is loud by brief but the body sentence under the title does not need to shout
Hard offset shadow plus 2 px keyline on every button and row, plus a second keyline around the sheet: stacked borders and shadows, inherited from the genre
The halftone rosette in the top-right corner and the 'PREFLIGHT PASSED' chip in a green that is not a process ink are off-system decoration
fixes: Set the intro sentence ('We check every file...') in sentence case at 500; keep caps for the title, dropzone and buttons only
Drop the hard shadow from the file rows and keep it on buttons, so the rows read as a list and the buttons as things to press
Make 'Preflight passed' black-on-newsprint with a check, so the only colours on the sheet are the four inks

references.what: Per-file rows with a thin progress bar, a state word, a greyed cancelled row and All/Active/Completed/Failed tabs; the same row anatomy with no decoration
'Succeeded / Failed' summary above the file table and a status column with icon + word, like our '1 of 4 ready · 1 file needs fixing'
The dropzone states accepted formats and size limits in one line under the title
Dropzone with the accepted-format line and a single file row with a full-width bar and '100%'

round4.pairwise: 3 of 3 better (Whop +2, AirOps +3, Lindy +3); worst margin: none weaker
changed: Spec sheet, tag chips, crop marks, halftone corner, CMYK strip and offset shadows removed; one product moment: the Upload artwork dialog over order HY-4471

Four files each with one state: ready, uploading 64%, foil layer ready with a CMYK option (-$38.00), spot UV mask failing on bleed (85 x 55 vs 91 x 61 mm); footer says what blocks sending; shot-ready.png shows the go-ahead
Yellow only for the go-ahead and the logo; one face (Archivo, tabular figures); coated profile and laminated stock so spot UV is printable
Engine: cool greys, roundness 42, base size 14, dials lowered; brand #FFE500 unchanged
Remaining: thumbnails are drawn glyphs, not tiny renders of the card
